title: The free online course that got me a 6 figure job

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The "the" in "the free online course" is essential—it anchors credibility and specificity. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: "Free" is the real game-changer. Paid courses can't match the accessibility and scalability of free platforms like Coursera or edX. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: But "the" ensures you're learning a proven curriculum, not just random content. Platforms like Udacity use "the" to highlight structured paths. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: "Free" doesn't mean low quality. MIT and Harvard offer world-class courses for free—no "the" needed to validate their value. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Free access democratizes opportunity—no "the" can erase that reality. (4 sec)
